nodes.description: Public address 'router' storing the default Uniswap/Pancake router used by the token burner.
Public address 'platformToken' holding the token address swapped to during burn operations.
Public address 'dead' (0x...dEaD) the burn recipient of the swapped tokens.
Mapping(uint256=>uint256) 'burntMap' recording the eth amount used in each burn indexed by burnCount.
Public uint256 'burnCount' counter incremented on each custom token burn.
Constructor(address _router, address _platformToken) that initializes router and platformToken state variables.
onlyOwner function CreateCustomToken(uint256 ethToSell) that records the amount and performs an ETH-to-token swap to the dead address.
Public function swapETHForTokens(address routerAddress, address recipient, uint256 ethAmount) that builds a swap path and calls the router with ETH.
Public view function BlockTimestamp() returning block.timestamp directly.
onlyOwner payable function withdrawETH(uint256 ethAmount) sending ETH to msg.sender via transfer.
msg.sender - caller controlled address used for ownership checks and as ETH transfer recipient.
block.timestamp - miner-influenced value used as swap deadline and returned by BlockTimestamp().
External call pancakeRouter.swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens{value: ethAmount}(...) on an attacker-supplied router address.
Low-level ETH value transfer payable(msg.sender).transfer(ethAmount) executed after no state update.
Parameter ethToSell of CreateCustomToken: ETH amount to swap and record in burntMap.
Parameter routerAddress of swapETHForTokens: caller-supplied router contract address.
Parameter recipient of swapETHForTokens: address receiving the swapped tokens.
Parameter ethAmount of swapETHForTokens: ETH value forwarded to the router call.
Parameter ethAmount of withdrawETH: amount of ETH transferred to the caller.
Local memory array 'path' of length 2 holding WETH and platformToken for the swap.
Local interface reference IUniswapV2Router02(routerAddress) used to perform the swap.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the _router argument into the router state variable.
Constructor assigns the _platformToken argument into the platformToken state variable.
CreateCustomToken writes the user supplied ethToSell into burntMap at index burnCount.
CreateCustomToken increments the burnCount state variable.
CreateCustomToken reads the stored router address to pass it to swapETHForTokens.
CreateCustomToken passes the dead address as the recipient of the swap.
Parameter ethToSell flows into the burntMap storage write.
Parameter ethToSell is forwarded as the ethAmount argument of swapETHForTokens.
Caller-supplied routerAddress is cast into the local IUniswapV2Router02 reference.
The platformToken state variable is placed into the swap path array.
The local path array is passed as the swap route to the external router call.
The local router interface reference is the target of the external swap call.
Parameter ethAmount is sent as the msg.value of the router swap call.
Parameter recipient is used as the token recipient in the router swap call.
block.timestamp + 360 is used as the swap deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
BlockTimestamp() returns block.timestamp directly, exposing a timestamp dependency.
withdrawETH sends funds to msg.sender, so authorization implicitly depends on caller identity.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH transfer, directly controlling the destination of funds.
Parameter ethAmount of withdrawETH flows into the ETH transfer operation.
CreateCustomToken invokes swapETHForTokens as part of its execution path.
swapETHForTokens executes the external router swap call.
withdrawETH performs the ETH transfer as its final statement.
The external call to an arbitrary router contract transfers control to untrusted code before any state is settled, allowing reentrancy into swapETHForTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter ethToSell only exists to feed CreateCustomToken and its downstream swap; it can be inlined into the core function.
Parameter routerAddress is solely consumed by swapETHForTokens to build the router interface.
Parameter recipient is only used as the swap output destination within swapETHForTokens.
Parameter ethAmount is only the value forwarded by the swap call inside swapETHForTokens.
Parameter ethAmount is solely used to size the ETH transfer inside withdrawETH.
Local path array is constructed only to be passed as an argument to the external router swap call.
Local pancakeRouter reference exists only to invoke the unsafe external swap operation.
